hbq.definition: Retained canonical 178-question bank, twenty-three packets per story; user prompt bytes unchanged. Schema portability only, with retained and emitted hashes.
hbq.score: Historical deterministic scoring snapshot bound by retained plan; candidate scoring is a separate analysis condition.

ttcw14.definition: Fourteen literal source questions and interpretive definitions in one concise-evidence packet. Terminal reasoning/list-enumeration and binary-only output instructions replaced; no NOT_APPLICABLE; true CANNOT_ASSESS retained.
ttcw14.score: YES fraction of assessed tests, with assessed/14 coverage; do not present partial totals as full fourteen-test scores.

holistic.definition: Named adult-prose-fiction descendant, seven anchored levels, exact evidence, explicit abstention envelope.

compact.definition: Named adult-prose-fiction descendant; six dimensions plus independent overall judgment. Technology-specific setting wording generalized; explicit abstention envelope.
compact.score: Native independently judged overall 1-5; dimension mean is diagnostic only.

oregon.definition: Named TTCW descendant of the existing six-trait Oregon 2017 research implementation, with explicit abstention envelope; educational/adult literary target mismatch disclosed.
oregon.score: Native exact sum of six integer 1-6 traits, range 6-36.

pairwise.definition: Standalone independent editorial comparison; both orders; genuine ties distinct from cannot-assess; no HBQ report, gate outcome, source generator, title, or quality target included.
pairwise.score: Within-plot direction only; never create a global ranking from twelve disconnected graphs.
